quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, it is usually best to:

options.text: Drive slowly and wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic already on the freeway.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the speed of freeway traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the speed of freeway traffic.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up and match freeway traffic speed. This helps you merge smoothly and safely. Vehicles entering the freeway must yield to traffic already on it.

questions.question: Drivers should drive in a center turn lane for no more than:
questions.explanation: You can stay in a center turn lane for no more than 200 feet before making a left turn. After turning left onto the road, you can stay in a center turn lane for only 50 feet before joining traffic.

questions.question: Signs showing areas for public recreation are:
questions.explanation: Brown signs show areas of historical importance or public recreation. They help you find these places when traveling in unfamiliar areas.

questions.question: Cars begin to lose traction and hydroplane at a speed of 70 mph.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, cars can lose traction and hydroplane at speeds as low as 35 mph. When this happens, you lose control of your car. Slow down when driving in rain.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph could take up to ____ to stop completely.
questions.explanation: Tractor-trailers need longer distances to stop than smaller cars at the same speed. A fully loaded tractor-trailer may need almost 400 feet to stop when traveling at 55 mph.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill or incline with a curb:

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb when parking facing uphill. This stops your car from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail. If there is no curb, turn the wheels sharply toward the road edge.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. Low vehicles may drag on or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: When driving past a vehicle that just parked on the side of the road, you should:

options.text: Expect that the driver will open the car door as you approach.
Assume the driver will wait until you pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Expect that the driver will open the car door as you approach.
questions.explanation: When passing a car that just parked, expect the driver to open the door as you approach. Drive carefully and watch for opening doors near parked vehicles.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, you:

options.text: Must drive slowly to give approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to move.
Must honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know to move.
Must stop and only proceed when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
Can ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must stop and only proceed when no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the road from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians. You must stop before crossing the sidewalk. Failure to stop is against the law.

questions.question: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means:

options.text: Passing on the left is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane next to the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane next to the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane next to the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass only if you are in the lane next to the broken line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What is the most important thing to remember about speed and curves?

options.text: Drive at the speed limit as you enter the curve. Then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: You must slow down before entering a curve. Your vehicle's momentum makes it harder to turn. Slowing down first helps you keep control.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be considered:

options.text: Safe to cross because trains rarely come.
Safe places to park a car.
Places where you must always stop.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Always look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and directions from flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest driving season.
Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid in winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Snow tires are best for winter driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other dangerous conditions. Winter is the hardest driving season and needs extra care. Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid regularly. Snow tires help your vehicle grip slippery roads better.

questions.question: Talking or texting on your phone while driving will not increase your crash risk much.
questions.explanation: Using a phone while driving is a distraction that increases your risk of crashing.

questions.question: Which traffic light means you should slow down and be careful at an intersection?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you must slow down, be careful, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. High beams reflect off the fog and can shine back into your eyes.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ colored signs that show direction and distance information.
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background and show direction and distance to places. They are helpful when driving in new areas.

questions.question: You need extra space in front of your car when stopped:
questions.explanation: Leave more space in front of your car when stopped on an uphill slope. If the car in front rolls backward when traffic starts, extra space helps prevent a crash.

questions.question: A single broken yellow line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means drivers next to it can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: When driving on city streets, signal to turn ____ before you begin a turn.
questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn on city streets. This tells other drivers what you plan to do. Keep signaling until you finish the turn or lane change.

questions.question: If a traffic light shows both red and a green arrow, you cannot turn in the direction of the arrow until the red light changes.
questions.explanation: You can turn in the direction of the green arrow after you yield to any traffic or pedestrians in the intersection. The other lights do not stop you from turning.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, complete the turn into:

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Turn into the lane that is closest to your previous lane. This is always the safest way to turn.

questions.question: If a green arrow becomes a solid green light, you:

options.text: Can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic.
Can no longer turn and must go straight.
Still have the right-of-way to turn.
No longer need to turn in the arrow's direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can still turn, but must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: You can still turn in the arrow's direction when it becomes a solid green light. But you must first yield to pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When you see reduced visibility, your first action should be:
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed first when visibility decreases. This is the most important action when conditions become dangerous.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a low overhead structure. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What is a safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down when you enter, speed up when you exit.
Keep the same speed throughout the curve.
Speed up when you enter, slow down when you exit.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when you enter, speed up when you exit.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve. Then gradually increase your speed as you exit. Speeding up into a curve makes your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light means:

options.text: Drivers must stop until the light turns green.
Drivers must slow down and be careful.
It means the same thing as a stop sign.
Drivers should quickly leave the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light is the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: When parallel parking, park within ____ inches of the curb.
questions.explanation: Your wheels must be within 18 inches of the curb when parallel parking. Make sure you do not block traffic and that other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be present ahead.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down once you are on the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same once on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic in the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down once you are on the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down until you move onto the exit ramp.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks next to each other, what should you do?

options.text: It is always safe to proceed after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
When one train passes, check the other track before proceeding.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: When one train passes, check the other track before proceeding.
questions.explanation: With two tracks side by side, watch for a second train after one passes. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming on either track.

questions.question: To check your blind spot when changing lanes to the left, look:
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.question: Is it safe to use cruise control on snowy or icy roads if you reduce your speed?
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snowy or icy roads. Your tires may lose grip and you will lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: When making a right turn on a green light, you must:

options.text: Stop and look for police cars.

questions.explanation: You may turn right on a green light unless a sign says you cannot. When you turn, you must give way to other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: If a car with high beams is coming toward you, look toward which side of the road?
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road to avoid being blinded by the other car's lights. This lets you see the road well enough to stay safe until the car passes.

questions.question: Do highways and roads freeze before ramps and bridges?
questions.explanation: Ramps and bridges freeze faster because they hang in the air. Drive slowly when crossing a bridge in freezing weather.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, you should:

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear and use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: When may you cross solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass traffic moving in the same direction.

questions.explanation: Broken lines may be crossed, but solid lines may not. You may only cross a solid yellow line when you are turning.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control how traffic moves. They are white with black markings. Drivers must always obey them.

questions.question: When making an emergency roadside stop, you do not need to use your parking brake.
questions.explanation: Always set your parking brake during an emergency roadside stop. Turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers.

questions.question: A solid white line down the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Drivers cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means drivers cannot pass.

questions.question: To turn left from a multi-lane, one-way street or highway, you should start from:
questions.explanation: Always start a left turn from the left lane of a multi-lane street or highway.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular yield sign means you must slow down as you approach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a complete stop at this intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross first. Stop completely if traffic conditions require it.

questions.question: When you drive faster:

options.text: It is easier to see cross traffic.

questions.explanation: The faster you drive, the narrower your field of vision becomes. As your speed increases, you see less. You must watch more carefully for hazards.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: Pentagon-shaped signs mark school zones. Be alert for children and pedestrians near schools.

questions.question: If your car has Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS) and loses traction on a slippery road, you should:

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal down.
Press and hold the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal down.
questions.explanation: If you lose traction, press the brake pedal hard and keep it pressed. Steer out of danger. ABS automatically pumps the brakes faster than you can. Do not pump the brakes or ease up on the pedal, as this will turn off the ABS.

questions.question: When you follow another vehicle crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You can pass slower drivers while crossing the tracks.
Make sure your vehicle can cross the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle can cross the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Check that you have enough room to cross the entire railroad track without stopping. Never pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing any tracks.
